atScene.en: No effective chest movement means no negative intrathoracic pressure—air will not come in on its own. The only way to move air then is positive pressure: bag-mask, pocket face mask, or a mechanical ventilator.
atScene.zh: 胸廓没有有效起伏＝胸腔产生不了负压，空气不会自己进来。这时唯一的进气方式是正压通气：皮囊面罩、口袋面罩或机械通气机。

atScene.en: Four history questions that predict a crash: Have you ever been kept overnight in the ED, admitted to hospital, admitted to an ICU, or intubated for this same problem? Any yes raises the odds of rapid deterioration—prepare accordingly.
atScene.zh: 预判恶化的四个病史问题：同样的毛病你是否曾在急诊留观过夜？住过院？进过 ICU？被插过管？任何一个「是」都预示可能快速恶化——提前做好准备。

atScene.en: When in doubt, look at the patient: if the person is blue and struggling, ignore a reassuring pulse-ox number and treat what you see.
atScene.zh: 拿不准时看患者本人：如果人已发绀、在拼命呼吸，就无视那个「还不错」的血氧读数，按眼前的病情处理。

atScene.en: Waveform capnography is the minimum standard for transporting an intubated patient. Before rolling: batteries charged, backup power confirmed, alarm limits and volumes set—so any parameter drifting out of range alerts you instantly.
atScene.zh: 转运插管患者，波形二氧化碳监测是最低标准。出发前：设备电量充足、备用电源确认、报警上下限和音量设好——任何参数越界都能第一时间提醒你。

atScene.en: PPE floor for airway work: gloves for every airway/ventilation procedure; add mask and eye protection or a face shield when placing an advanced airway; gown for heavy blood splash. Suction an intubated patient only through a closed in-line system.
atScene.zh: 气道操作的防护底线：任何气道/通气操作至少戴手套；放高级气道时加口罩和护目镜或面屏；大量血液飞溅再加隔离衣。给已插管病人吸引，只能走密闭式在线吸引系统。

atScene.en: OPA insertion shortcut: glide along the hard palate until you feel the bump of the soft palate — rotate 180° right there and the tip will catch the tongue base and carry it forward.
atScene.zh: OPA 插入捷径：贴着硬腭滑行，指下一感到软腭的「小坎」就地旋转 180°，尖端正好兜住舌根把它带向前方。

atScene.en: Severe obstruction clock: a fully obstructed patient has only minutes before profound hypoxia. While you run BLS rounds, your partner should already be laying out laryngoscope handle, blade, and Magill forceps — so the escalation (where authorized) costs zero extra seconds.
atScene.zh: 重度梗阻的倒计时：完全梗阻的病人离重度缺氧只有几分钟。你做 BLS 循环的同时，搭档就该把喉镜柄、镜片和 Magill 钳摆好——一旦需要升级（在授权范围内），不再浪费一秒。

atScene.en: Oxygen logistics discipline: check the main cylinder at shift start, check portables after every oxygen call, swap at 200 psi, and never leave station without a backup cylinder.
atScene.zh: 氧气后勤纪律：接班查主供瓶，每趟用氧任务后查便携瓶，200 psi 就换，出车永远带备用瓶。

atScene.en: Do not force CPAP onto a panicking patient — let them hold the mask to their own face first, coach them through the first minutes, then strap. Forcing it spikes anxiety and oxygen demand, the exact opposite of the goal.
atScene.zh: 别把 CPAP 硬扣到恐慌的病人脸上——先让他自己扶着面罩感受，头几分钟全程安抚，适应了再上头带。硬来只会推高焦虑和耗氧，与目的背道而驰。

atScene.en: If SpO2 keeps falling despite your best manual airway and ventilation efforts, stop chasing a perfect preoxygenation number - proceed to intubation without delay.
atScene.zh: 如果在最佳人工气道加通气下 SpO2 仍持续下滑，就别再执着于预氧合达标——立即转入插管，不再等。

atScene.en: Trauma airway is a two-paramedic job: one holds manual in-line stabilization in neutral, the other intubates. The sniffing position is off the table.
atScene.zh: 创伤气道是双人活：一人中立位徒手轴线固定头颈，另一人插管。嗅物位从选项里划掉。

atScene.en: In cardiac arrest the tube never outranks compressions: if it will not go in within the window, go back to bagging - compressions do not pause for laryngoscopy.
atScene.zh: 骤停现场导管的优先级永远低于按压：窗口期内插不进就回去捏球囊——按压绝不为喉镜暂停。

atScene.en: Check the intubation kit at the start of every shift; the bulb test is 'bright, white, steady, tight' - a loose bulb can end up aspirated into the airway.
atScene.zh: 每个班次开始就核查插管包；灯泡口诀『亮、白、稳、紧』——拧不紧的灯泡可能整颗掉进气道被吸入。

atScene.en: A video laryngoscope is only as good as its lens: one fleck of blood blinds it. Keep the camera ahead of secretions and suction before advancing.
atScene.zh: 视频喉镜的上限就是镜头的洁净度：一点血渍就致盲。让镜头始终走在分泌物前面，先吸引再推进。

atScene.en: Combativeness, aggression, and belligerence are cerebral hypoxia until proven otherwise - the patient is fighting for air, not fighting you.
atScene.zh: 好斗、攻击性、不配合，先当脑缺氧处理直到证明不是——患者是在为呼吸挣扎，不是在跟你作对。

atScene.en: A paralyzed patient can hear, feel, and think - paralysis without sedation is considered patient abuse. Sedative first, always.
atScene.zh: 被瘫痪的患者听得见、感觉得到、想得明白——只瘫痪不镇静被视为虐待患者。镇静永远在前。

atScene.en: Attempt RSI only when you are confident you can intubate - or keep the patient oxygenated and ventilated if you cannot. Otherwise the person you paralyzed dies.
atScene.zh: 只有确信『插得进，插不进也能维持氧合通气』才许启动 RSI——否则被你瘫痪的患者就是死路一条。

atScene.en: During blind nasotracheal intubation, keep a laryngoscope and Magill forceps within arm's reach: if the patient goes apneic mid-procedure you must finish under direct vision.
atScene.zh: 盲探经鼻插管时，喉镜和 Magill 钳必须放在伸手可及处：患者中途一旦呼吸停止，就得改直视完成。

confusions.en: "He is talking, so the airway is fine." Talking only proves the airway is open this minute. Fatigue, swelling, or bleeding can close it soon after—always judge the trajectory, not the snapshot.
confusions.zh: 「他还能说话，气道就没事。」能说话只证明此刻通畅。疲劳、肿胀、出血都可能很快把气道关掉——要判断趋势，不是只看这一眼。

confusions.en: "Oxygen fixes respiratory distress." Oxygen improves oxygenation only; it does nothing for failing ventilation. When tidal volume or effort is inadequate, the answer is assisted ventilation, not just a higher flow rate.
confusions.zh: 「给了氧，呼吸窘迫就解决了。」氧只改善氧合，救不了衰竭中的通气。潮气量或呼吸做功不够时，答案是辅助通气，而不是把氧流量再调大。

confusions.en: "SpO2 looks normal, so the patient is safe." The number lies with CO poisoning, motion, and poor perfusion—and a tiring patient can hold a good number right up until collapse.
confusions.zh: 「血氧读数正常＝患者安全。」CO 中毒、肢体晃动、灌注差时读数都会骗人——而且正在耗竭的患者可以把读数撑到崩溃前一刻。

confusions.en: "Airway management means placing an advanced airway." Most airway care is positioning, suction, basic adjuncts, and bag-mask ventilation; rushing to advanced devices is itself a documented cause of increased mortality.
confusions.zh: 「气道管理＝上高级气道。」绝大多数气道处理靠体位、吸引、基础辅助器械和皮囊面罩通气；急着上高级器械本身就是被点名的增加死亡率的原因。

confusions.en: "Wait for full apnea before assisting ventilation." Assist when breathing turns inadequate—abnormal rate plus shallow volume or altered mentation. Waiting for arrest means the safest window has already passed.
confusions.zh: 「等呼吸完全停了再辅助通气。」呼吸变得不充分——频率异常＋潮气量浅或意识改变——就该介入。等到呼吸停止，最安全的干预窗口早就错过了。

confusions.en: "A fast rate means good ventilation." Fast-and-shallow breaths may only shuttle air through dead space; minute alveolar volume can be a quarter of normal despite a rate of 40. Judge depth and chest rise, not rate alone.
confusions.zh: 「呼吸快＝通气好。」又快又浅的呼吸可能只在死腔里来回倒气；频率 40 次/分时肺泡通气量照样可以只有正常的四分之一。要看深度和胸廓起伏，不能只数次数。

confusions.en: "COPD patients must not get much oxygen because of the hypoxic drive." The hypoxic drive matters essentially only in end-stage COPD, and BC explicitly indicates high-flow oxygen for COPD patients short of breath. Never withhold oxygen from a hypoxic patient.
confusions.zh: 「COPD 患者有低氧驱动，不能多给氧。」低氧驱动基本只见于终末期 COPD，而且 BC 考纲明确：COPD 患者气促时就该用高流量氧。绝不能因为这个顾虑对缺氧患者扣着氧不给。

confusions.en: "Low ETCO2 in arrest means the tube is in the esophagus." Prolonged arrest itself yields minimal exhaled CO2 (severe acidosis, poor CO2 return to the lungs). Confirm with the waveform plus multiple methods before pulling a tube.
confusions.zh: 「骤停时 ETCO2 低＝管子插进食管了。」长时间骤停本身就会让呼出 CO2 极低（严重酸中毒、回肺 CO2 少）。要结合波形和多种确认手段，别急着拔管。

confusions.en: "Cheyne-Stokes and Biot respirations are the same kind of bad." Cheyne-Stokes is not automatically ominous; Biot—chaotic breathing with apnea spells—signals raised intracranial pressure. Exams love swapping the two.
confusions.zh: 「潮式呼吸和比奥呼吸都一样凶险。」潮式呼吸并不必然是凶兆；比奥呼吸——节律紊乱夹呼吸暂停——才提示颅内压增高。考试特别爱把这两个对调设坑。

confusions.en: "Compliance direction is confusing." Increased compliance = the bag squeezes easily = air flows in freely. Decreased compliance = squeezing gets hard = suspect obstruction. Students routinely flip this.
confusions.zh: 「顺应性方向容易记反。」顺应性高＝皮囊好捏＝气进得顺；顺应性下降＝越捏越费劲＝警惕气道梗阻。这个方向经常被学生记反。

confusions.en: 'The patient is talking, so the airway is fine.' Talking proves patency THIS minute — swelling, bleeding, fatigue, and falling LOC can close it within minutes. Track the trajectory, not the snapshot.
confusions.zh: 「病人还在说话，气道没事。」说话只证明这一分钟是通的——肿胀、出血、疲劳和意识下滑可以在几分钟内把它关上。要盯的是走向，不是快照。

confusions.en: 'Oxygen fixes breathing problems.' Oxygen fixes oxygenation only; a hypoventilating patient needs VENTILATION assistance. Piling on oxygen while CO2 climbs is a classic exam trap and a real-world killer.
confusions.zh: 「给氧就能解决呼吸问题。」氧只解决氧合；通气不足的病人需要的是辅助通气。一边堆氧一边放任 CO2 攀升，是经典考试陷阱，也是现实中的杀手。

confusions.en: 'Lower mask flow is gentler.' Below 6 L/min an adult face mask becomes a rebreathing chamber — worse than room air. If the patient cannot tolerate proper flow, change the device, not the flow.
confusions.zh: 「面罩流量调低一点更温和。」成人面罩低于 6 L/min 就成了呼出气回收罐——比呼吸室内空气还差。病人受不了标准流量，就换装置，不是调低流量。

confusions.en: 'A nonrebreather helps every dyspneic patient.' It is passive: shallow tidal volumes cannot open its one-way valve, so the sickest breathers get almost nothing. Inadequate depth = switch to assisted BVM ventilation.
confusions.zh: 「非再吸入面罩对所有呼吸困难都有用。」它是被动装置：潮气量太浅根本拉不开单向阀，越重的病人拿到的越少。呼吸深度不够＝改球囊辅助通气。

confusions.en: 'CPAP is for the crashing patient.' Backwards — imminent or actual respiratory failure (slow shallow breathing, dropping LOC) is a CONTRAINDICATION. Those patients need BVM with PEEP; CPAP is for the awake, working-hard-but-losing patient.
confusions.zh: 「病人快不行了，赶紧上 CPAP。」正好说反——即将或已经呼吸衰竭（呼吸慢浅、意识往下掉）恰恰是禁忌。那种病人要的是 BVM 加 PEEP；CPAP 属于清醒的、还在奋力呼吸但渐渐落败的人。

confusions.en: 'Suction until it looks clean.' Every second of suction steals oxygen. Preoxygenate first, obey the time caps, and expect vagal bradycardia if you linger in a small child's pharynx.
confusions.zh: 「一口气吸到干净为止。」吸引的每一秒都在偷走氧。先预氧合、严守时限，在幼儿咽部逗留还会招来迷走性心动过缓。

confusions.en: 'A gagging patient can tolerate an OPA if you push past it.' Any gag = wrong device. Pull it out, ready the suction, and go nasopharyngeal instead.
confusions.zh: 「病人有点恶心，OPA 忍一忍就进去了。」出现咽反射＝用错装置。拔出来、备好吸引，改走鼻咽通气道。

confusions.en: 'Abdominal thrusts are the only correct answer for adult choking.' The textbook leads with the Heimlich, but the BC exam accepts back slaps, chest thrusts, and abdominal thrusts — alternating two techniques in sets of five is explicitly acceptable.
confusions.zh: 「成人噎住只有腹部冲击一个标准答案。」教材以 Heimlich 为主，但 BC 考纲认可背部拍击、胸部冲击、腹部冲击三种手法——两种手法五次一组交替也明确可接受。

confusions.en: 'I can intubate' is not 'I should intubate.' Advanced airways exist for exactly two failures - patency or oxygenation/ventilation. Skipping basics to reach for the laryngoscope on an already-hypoxemic arrest patient is the chapter's number-one named error.
confusions.zh: 『会插管』不等于『该插管』。高级气道只对应两种失败——通畅维持不住，或氧合通气不达标。跳过基础手法、对着已经低氧的骤停患者直接亮喉镜，是本章点名批评的头号错误。

confusions.en: Paralytics are not sedatives: they freeze every skeletal muscle while consciousness, hearing, and pain stay fully intact. The drug that stops the breathing does nothing for the fear.
confusions.zh: 瘫痪药不是镇静药：它冻结全部骨骼肌，而意识、听觉、痛觉原封不动。让呼吸停下来的那支药，对恐惧毫无作用。

confusions.en: A Combitube resting in the esophagus is not a misplacement - that is its expected home. The lethal error is ventilating through the wrong lumen without recognizing it: zero air reaches the lungs.
confusions.zh: Combitube 落在食管不是插错了——那本来就是它的预期位置。真正致命的错误是从错误管腔通气而不自知：肺一点气都没进。

confusions.en: Needle cricothyrotomy 'works' only in one direction: oxygen goes in, but CO2 barely comes out. PaCO2 climbs the whole time - it is a bridge measured in minutes, not a destination.
confusions.zh: 针刺环甲膜只在一个方向上『有效』：氧进得去，CO2 却几乎排不出来。PaCO2 全程上爬——它是按分钟计的过桥手段，不是终点。

confusions.en: Tube misting and the esophageal detector device feel reassuring and prove nothing. Confirmation demands at least two methods, and one must be ETCO2 - waveform capnography is the standard.
confusions.zh: 管内起雾、食管探测球看着让人安心，但什么都证明不了。确认必须至少两种手段，其中一种必须是 ETCO2——标准是波形二氧化碳图。

confusions.en: The LMA fixes the mask-seal problem, not the aspiration problem - if the patient regurgitates, the device may funnel stomach contents straight into the trachea.
confusions.zh: LMA 解决的是面罩密封问题，不是误吸问题——患者一旦反流，罩体反而可能把胃内容物直接导进气管。

confusions.en: Breath sounds on the right only does not mean re-intubate: the tube is simply too deep in the right mainstem. Deflate, withdraw slowly to bilateral equality, and re-secure - pulling it out entirely throws away a working airway.
confusions.zh: 只有右侧有呼吸音不等于要重插：只是管子插深进了右主支气管。放囊、缓慢回退到双侧对称、重新固定即可——整根拔掉等于白扔一条已经建立的气道。

confusions.en: NG and OG are not interchangeable defaults: NG suits the responsive patient but is banned with midface/skull fractures; OG suits the unresponsive patient and normally goes in only after the tracheal tube - earlier, it blocks your view of the cords.
confusions.zh: NG 和 OG 不是随手互换的默认项：NG 适合清醒患者、但中面部/颅底骨折绝对禁用；OG 适合无意识患者、且通常等气管插管完成后再下——提前下管会挡住声带视野。

mnemonics.name: Yellow = Yes
mnemonics.en: Colourimetric ETCO2: Yellow = Yes, the tube is tracheal; Purple = Problem, think esophageal.
mnemonics.zh: 比色 CO2 检测：变黄＝Yes，管在气管；持续紫＝Problem，警惕食管。

mnemonics.name: 吸一呼二
mnemonics.en: Each ventilation cycle: inspiration one-third, expiration two-thirds.
mnemonics.zh: 每个通气周期：吸气占 1/3，呼气占 2/3——「吸一呼二」。

mnemonics.en: Tidal 500 minus dead space 150 leaves 350 mL of alveolar volume—only that 350 exchanges gas.
mnemonics.zh: 潮气量 500 减死腔 150，剩 350 mL 肺泡容量——真正换气的只有那 350。

mnemonics.name: 儿童气道五不同
mnemonics.en: Peds airway: Big occiput, Big tongue, Small jaw, High anterior larynx, Cricoid narrowest under age 10.
mnemonics.zh: 儿童气道五不同：枕大、舌大、颌小、喉高靠前、10 岁以下环状软骨最窄。

mnemonics.name: 鲨鱼鳍＝痉挛
mnemonics.en: A shark-fin capnograph waveform = bronchospasm (asthma/COPD air trapping).
mnemonics.zh: 二氧化碳波形呈鲨鱼鳍状＝支气管痉挛（哮喘/COPD 气体潴留）。

mnemonics.name: 35～45 用两次
mnemonics.en: The range 35-45 mm Hg serves twice: normal PaCO2 and normal ETCO2 (ETCO2 runs 2-5 lower).
mnemonics.zh: 35～45 这组数用两次：既是 PaCO2 正常范围，也是 ETCO2 正常范围（ETCO2 略低 2～5）。

mnemonics.en: Suction caps shrink with the patient: adult 15 (BC: 10-15), child 10, infant 5 seconds.
mnemonics.zh: 吸引时限跟着病人个头缩水：成人 15（BC 写 10-15）、儿童 10、婴儿 5 秒。

mnemonics.name: 有反射走鼻路
mnemonics.en: Gag reflex present → NPA via the nose; no gag reflex → OPA via the mouth. Both are measured to the earlobe — OPA from the mouth corner, NPA from the nostril tip.
mnemonics.zh: 咽反射在→鼻咽通气道；反射没了→口咽通气道。两个都量到耳垂——OPA 从口角起量，NPA 从鼻尖起量。

mnemonics.en: BC CPAP gate: at least 13 years old, RR above 24, SpO2 below 94% on oxygen (plus accessory muscle use, awake, airway intact).
mnemonics.zh: BC CPAP 门槛：满 13 岁、呼吸频率超 24、给氧下 SpO2 不到 94%（外加辅助肌参与、清醒、气道自保）。

mnemonics.en: CPAP and PEEP share one dial rule: start 5 cmH2O, step up by 2.5, ceiling 10.
mnemonics.zh: CPAP 和 PEEP 共用一条旋钮口诀：5 起步、2.5 一档、10 封顶。

mnemonics.name: 同是 15，差三档
mnemonics.en: At 15 L/min: BVM+reservoir ≈100%, nonrebreather ≈90%, pocket mask ≈55%.
mnemonics.zh: 同样 15 L/min 三件装备三个数：球囊带储袋≈100%、非再吸入面罩≈90%、口对面罩≈55%。

mnemonics.name: Squeeze-Release-Release
mnemonics.en: Pediatric bagging cadence — one second to squeeze, two beats to let go: one breath every 3-5 seconds, 12-20/min.
mnemonics.zh: 儿科捏袋节奏——挤 1 秒、松 2 拍：每 3-5 秒一口气，合 12-20 次/分。

mnemonics.name: MOANS
mnemonics.en: Difficult bag-mask ventilation: Mask seal, Obese, Aged, No teeth, Stiff lungs.
mnemonics.zh: 预判球囊面罩通气困难：密封难、肥胖、高龄、无牙、肺硬（顺应性差）。

mnemonics.name: LEMON
mnemonics.en: Difficult intubation: Look externally, Evaluate 3-3-2, Mallampati, Obstruction, Neck mobility.
mnemonics.zh: 预判插管困难：看外观、量 3-3-2、Mallampati 分级、找梗阻、查颈部活动度。

mnemonics.name: BURP
mnemonics.en: Backward-Upward-Rightward Pressure on the lower third of the thyroid cartilage to improve the laryngoscopic view.
mnemonics.zh: 改善喉镜视野的按压方向：在甲状软骨下 1/3 向背侧、头侧、右侧加压。

mnemonics.name: DOPE
mnemonics.en: Sudden deterioration in an intubated patient: Displacement, Obstruction, Pneumothorax, Equipment failure.
mnemonics.zh: 已插管患者突然恶化的四大排查：管移位、管堵塞、气胸、设备故障。

mnemonics.name: 亮白稳紧
mnemonics.en: Laryngoscope bulb check: bright, white, steady, tight - the loose bulb is an aspiration hazard.
mnemonics.zh: 喉镜灯泡四字诀：亮（刺眼才够亮）、白（不发黄）、稳（不闪烁）、紧（拧牢，防脱落被吸入）。

selfCheck.qEn: Normal respiratory rates for adult, child, and infant?
selfCheck.qZh: 成人、儿童、婴儿的正常呼吸频率各是多少？
selfCheck.aEn: Adult 12-20; child (1-18 y) 12-37; infant (1 mo-1 y) 30-53 breaths/min.

selfCheck.qEn: Formula for minute alveolar volume, and why fast-shallow breathing fails?
selfCheck.qZh: 分钟肺泡通气量的公式？为什么又快又浅的呼吸不行？
selfCheck.aEn: VA = (VT − VD) × RR. Shallow breaths mostly refill the 150 mL dead space, so little air reaches the alveoli no matter the rate.
selfCheck.aZh: VA＝（潮气量−死腔量）×呼吸频率。浅呼吸大部分只在 150 mL 死腔里打转，频率再快也没多少气到肺泡。

selfCheck.qEn: Why is pulse oximetry unreliable in CO poisoning?
selfCheck.qZh: CO 中毒时脉搏血氧仪为什么不可靠？
selfCheck.aEn: CO binds hemoglobin about 250 times more readily than oxygen, so carboxyhemoglobin fakes a normal SpO2; a CO-oximeter (SpCO) is needed.
selfCheck.aZh: CO 与血红蛋白的亲和力约是氧的 250 倍，碳氧血红蛋白会伪装成正常 SpO2；需要 CO 血氧仪（SpCO）才能识别。

selfCheck.qEn: The colourimetric CO2 detector stays purple after 6-8 breaths—what does that mean?
selfCheck.qZh: 比色 CO2 检测器通气 6～8 次后仍是紫色，说明什么？
selfCheck.aEn: Exhaled CO2 is under 0.5%—suspect esophageal placement (tracheal air carries 4-5% CO2 and turns it yellow).
selfCheck.aZh: 呼出 CO2 不足 0.5%——警惕导管在食管（气管内呼出气含 4%～5% CO2，会把试纸变黄）。

selfCheck.qEn: What does ROSC look like on capnography?
selfCheck.qZh: 自主循环恢复在二氧化碳波形上是什么表现？
selfCheck.aEn: An abrupt, sustained rise in ETCO2, typically above 40 mm Hg.
selfCheck.aZh: ETCO2 突然且持续升高，典型超过 40 mm Hg。

selfCheck.qEn: BC oxygen titration rule in one line?
selfCheck.qZh: BC 的氧疗滴定规则一句话？
selfCheck.aEn: Titrate to SpO2 ≥ 94% (max 15 L/min) unless SOB, shock, or CO poisoning—those get high-flow oxygen at once.
selfCheck.aZh: 按 SpO2 ≥94% 滴定（最高 15 L/min）；一旦气促、休克或 CO 中毒，直接上高流量氧。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Textbook: normal SpO2 is above 95%; aggressive oxygen is reserved for readings below 90% with respiratory distress.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材：SpO2 正常应 >95%；要到 <90% 且伴呼吸窘迫才要求积极给氧。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC: titrate oxygen to SpO2 ≥ 94% (up to 15 L/min) when the patient is not SOB or in shock; SOB, shock, or CO poisoning gets high-flow oxygen immediately.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 考纲：患者无气促、无休克时，按 SpO2 ≥94% 滴定给氧（最高 15 L/min）；气促、休克或 CO 中毒则直接高流量。答题一律以 94% 为准。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Textbook frames the hypoxic drive as the backup breathing control in end-stage COPD, which students often read as a reason to limit oxygen.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把低氧驱动描述为终末期 COPD 的备用呼吸调控，学生常据此推出「COPD 要限氧」。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC: high-flow oxygen IS indicated for COPD patients complaining of shortness of breath; routine COPD oxygen is nasal cannula at 1-3 L/min after acute treatment. Never withhold oxygen for fear of the hypoxic drive.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 考纲：COPD 患者主诉气促时，高流量氧就是适应证；急性处理后的常规给氧才是鼻导管 1～3 L/min。不能因低氧驱动顾虑而对缺氧患者限氧。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Textbook: begin positive-pressure support when breathing is inadequate, judged from rate, depth, sounds, mentation, and cyanosis.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材：呼吸不充分（频率、深度、呼吸音、意识、发绀综合判断）即开始正压支持。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC writes the trigger as an explicit rule: assist ventilations if the patient has altered LOC or SpO2 below 94%.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 考纲把启动线写成硬规则：意识改变或 SpO2 <94% 就应辅助通气。实操考按这条执行。

bcAlerts.topicZh: 清醒成人/儿童异物梗阻手法
bcAlerts.bookEn: Abdominal thrusts (Heimlich) as the primary technique until expulsion or collapse; chest thrusts only for pregnancy/obesity.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材以腹部冲击（Heimlich）为主线，做到排出或倒下；胸部冲击仅留给孕妇/肥胖。
bcAlerts.bcEn: Back slaps, chest thrusts, AND abdominal thrusts are all endorsed as feasible and effective; alternating two techniques in sets of five is acceptable; if abdominal thrusts fail, consider chest thrusts.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 认可背部拍击、胸部冲击、腹部冲击三种手法均可行有效；两种手法五次一组交替可接受；腹部冲击无效可改胸部冲击。答题按 BC。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Maximum 15 seconds per attempt in the adult.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材写成人单次最多 15 秒。
bcAlerts.bcEn: 10-15 seconds in the adult; 10 seconds pediatric; 5 seconds infant.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 写成人 10-15 秒、儿童 10 秒、婴儿 5 秒。数字题以 BC 区间为准。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Give oxygen for distress or SpO2 <94%; avoid routine hyperoxia.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材：呼吸窘迫或 SpO2＜94% 给氧，避免常规高氧。
bcAlerts.bcEn: Titrate to SpO2 ≥94%; SOB, shock, or CO poisoning get high-flow (NRB 15 L/min, may layer nasal cannula 15 L/min beneath); adult face mask never below 6 L/min; COPD maintenance is nasal cannula 1-3 L/min but acute COPD SOB still gets high-flow.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC：滴定到 SpO2 ≥94%；呼吸困难、休克、CO 中毒用高流量（NRB 15 L/min，可在面罩下叠 15 L/min 鼻导管）；成人面罩不得低于 6 L/min；COPD 平时鼻导管 1-3 L/min，但急性发作照样高流量。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Descriptive list: alert, moderate-severe distress, rapid breathing affecting minute volume, SpO2 <90%; broad contraindication list without an age cutoff.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材是描述式清单：清醒、中重度窘迫、呼吸过快影响分钟通气量、SpO2＜90%；禁忌一长串但没有年龄线。
bcAlerts.bcEn: Numeric gate: ≥13 years, awake/following commands, patent airway, RR>24 + SpO2<94% on O2 + accessory muscle use (all three); contraindications include ≤12 years and SBP <90 mmHg; settings 5→10 cmH2O in 2.5 steps. CPAP is a PCP-level skill.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 是数字门槛：≥13 岁、清醒遵嘱、气道自保、RR＞24＋给氧下 SpO2＜94%＋辅助肌使用三条全占；禁忌含 ≤12 岁和收缩压＜90；设置 5→10 cmH2O、每档 2.5。CPAP 属 PCP 授权技能。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Presented as the standard next step when BLS fails in the unresponsive patient.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把它列为无反应病人 BLS 失败后的标准下一步。
bcAlerts.bcEn: The BC exam FBAO algorithm ends at compressions-look-remove with blind sweeps banned; laryngoscope foreign-body retrieval is not in the written sequence — learn it as concept recognition only.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 考纲的 FBAO 流程到「按压—查看—看见才取、禁盲扫」为止，没有喉镜取异物这一步——按概念识别掌握即可，别当成考试操作流程去背。

bcAlerts.bookEn: This chapter's later sections teach tracheal intubation and alternative devices in depth (Combitube, LMA, King LT, i-gel).
bcAlerts.bookZh: 本章后段深入讲授气管插管和各类替代装置（Combitube、LMA、King LT、i-gel）。
bcAlerts.bcEn: For PCPs the authorized advanced airway is the supraglottic airway, inserted once high-quality arrest management is running; tracheal intubation is beyond PCP scope (ACP) — exams test concept recognition, not performance.
bcAlerts.bcZh: PCP 获授权的高级气道是声门上气道（SGA），在高质量骤停管理已建立后插入；气管插管超出 PCP 范围（属 ACP）——考试只考概念识别，不考操作。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Advanced airway scope for BC PCP
bcAlerts.topicZh: BC PCP 的高级气道授权边界
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook teaches the full ladder: tracheal intubation, RSI, and cricothyrotomy as paramedic skills.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把插管、RSI、环甲膜切开整套讲成 paramedic 技能。
bcAlerts.bcEn: In BC the PCP ceiling is the supraglottic airway: the cardiac arrest guideline authorizes SGA insertion for PCPs once high-quality arrest management is running. Intubation, drug-assisted intubation, and cricothyrotomy sit above PCP scope (ACP/CCP territory). The written exam can still test the concepts; prepare hands-on skills around BLS airway plus SGA.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 的 PCP 天花板是声门上气道：骤停指南写明『高质量骤停管理建立后，PCP 可置入 SGA』。插管、药物辅助插管、环甲膜切开都在 PCP 授权之上（属 ACP/CCP）。笔试仍可能考这些概念；实操按 BLS 气道手法＋SGA 来准备。
bcAlerts.ref: BC EMALB Guidelines 2026-06, CPR/AED Basic Concepts (p.42)

bcAlerts.topicEn: Airway drugs are not on the PCP formulary
bcAlerts.topicZh: 气道药物不在 PCP 药单上
bcAlerts.bookEn: The chapter details midazolam, ketamine, etomidate, propofol, succinylcholine, and rocuronium as airway-management drugs.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 本章把咪达唑仑、氯胺酮、依托咪酯、丙泊酚、琥珀胆碱、罗库溴铵当气道管理用药详细展开。
bcAlerts.bcEn: None of these appear among the 18 drug monographs in the BC PCP guidelines (acetaminophen through tranexamic acid). For BC exams they are knowledge-level content only - dosing recall matters for the written exam, but administration is outside EMR/PCP practice.
bcAlerts.bcZh: 这些药没有一个出现在 BC 指南的 18 个药物专论里（从对乙酰氨基酚到氨甲环酸）。对 BC 考试它们只是认知层面内容——笔试可能考剂量记忆，但给药本身超出 EMR/PCP 执业范围。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Suction duration is age-banded in BC
bcAlerts.topicZh: BC 吸引时长按年龄分档
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook caps tracheobronchial suctioning at 10-15 seconds in the adult and stoma suctioning at 10 seconds, without a pediatric breakdown here.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材写成人气管内吸引不超过 10-15 秒、造口吸引不超过 10 秒，此处没给儿科分档。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC states it explicitly by age: adult 10-15 s, child 10 s, infant 5 s. Answer age-banded on the BC exam.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 明确分龄：成人 10-15 秒、儿童 10 秒、婴儿 5 秒。BC 考试按分龄作答。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Arrest ventilation follows the 2020 resuscitation guidelines
bcAlerts.topicZh: 骤停通气以 2020 复苏指南为准
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook's arrest figure - 10 breaths/min without pausing compressions once an advanced airway is in - matches current guidelines.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材的骤停数字——高级气道建立后每分钟 10 次通气、按压不停——与现行指南一致。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC references Heart & Stroke 2020: before an SGA is placed, ventilate 30:2; after placement, asynchronous at 10/min. 'Avoid hyperventilation' is spelled out in the BC guideline and is a live deduction point in the practical exam.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 引用 Heart & Stroke 2020：SGA 置入前按 30:2；置入后改为不间断按压＋每分钟 10 次通气。『避免过度通气』在 BC 指南里是白纸黑字，也是实操考核的现成扣分点。
bcAlerts.ref: BC EMALB Guidelines 2026-06, CPR/AED Basic Concepts (p.42)
